summary: JBS N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing a voluntary transition from foreign private issuer filing status to filing SEC reports as a U.S. domestic company, starting with its Form 10-Q for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The change accelerates its disclosure calendar, with annual results on Form 10-K within 60 days and quarterly results within 40 days post-fiscal year end. JBS will maintain IFRS reporting with supplemental US GAAP indicators. No deal terms apply; this is a regulatory filing status change, not a special situation event.
